title: Electrical Warfare
description: A tech modpack focused around electrodynamics and its addons.
body:
Unleash the power of fusion reactors and atomic bombs with your friends in Electrical Warfare. Centered around Create, Mekanism, and Electrodynamics, this pack is designed for people who want to get a headache from complicated tech mods without the thousand hour commitment to gregtech.


Influenced by games like Ark and Rust, this pack is designed to give a challenge both in terms of survival and pvp. Survive the elements and build missiles to raid your enemy, or perhaps your friend.


General mod progression:
Silent Gear/Early Game Create
Create: TFMG
Electrodynamics
Mekanism
Draconic Evolution
Project E/Avaritia
